Question: In the angle bisector property, “the distances from a point to the two sides of the angle” refers to:

Choices.A: The distances from the point to the endpoints of the two sides
Choices.B: The lengths of the perpendicular segments from the point to the two sides
Choices.C: The distance from the point to the vertex
Choices.D: The distances from the point to any points on the two sides

Solution: The distance from a point to a line is the length of the perpendicular segment, so these are the lengths of the perpendicular segments \(PD\) and \(PE\) from \(P\) to \(OA\) and \(OB\).
